semanticReview.method: R33 source follow-up: reopened the article and prior review; consulted free institutional material; compared claims with locatable pages/sections; partial support is not extended to unsupported claims.
findings: La entrada generaliza la modalidad de わけがない a verbos, adjetivos, nombres y distintas polaridades/tiempos, además de describir restricciones y registros. Hace falta una fuente gramatical con ejemplos y localizadores para las formas nominales y las interpretaciones pragmáticas.
The official Irodori material consulted does not analyze わけがない. No free primary source with locator was found for its verb/adjective/noun combinations, polarity/tense, and pragmatic restrictions.
limitations: No se creó Evidence canónica ni se modificó el artículo.
La entrada permanece sin verificar hasta reunir respaldo suficiente para todas sus afirmaciones materiales.
There are still no source-to-claim locators for the main generalizations; a lexical dictionary entry for わけない is not a substitute.
No canonical Evidence was created and assessEntry did not pass; article unchanged and status not promoted to VERIFIED.
